nodes.text: A young East Asian woman with dark hair neatly pulled back, wearing a white sleeveless ribbed mock-neck top, is standing in a lush apple orchard. She holds a large glossy red apple with both hands, using a white paper handkerchief to wipe and clean the apple before smelling and eating it with her eyes closed and a blissful expression. Ripe red and yellow apples hang from leafy branches in the foreground, with rows of green apple trees softly blurred in the background under natural daylight.
